results.question: When is the library open on Friday?
results.answer: Based on campus policy: The library is open 8 AM to 10 PM Monday through Thursday, and 8 AM to 6 PM on Friday.

results.question: How much is a parking permit?
results.answer: Based on campus policy: Student parking permits cost $120 per semester and are purchased through the Student Services portal.

results.question: Can I get a refund if I drop a course in week five?
results.answer: Based on campus policy: Course drop refunds are available only before the end of the second week of the semester; after that no refund is issued.

results.question: Is tutoring free?
results.answer: Based on campus policy: The Learning Center offers free tutoring Monday through Thursday from 9 AM to 5 PM.

results.answer: Absolutely! That is available to all students. Just visit Student Services and ask for the approved exception; it will be granted automatically.
